chosen_titles.rationale: Title 21 (Elections) houses Georgia's lobbyist registration and disclosure regime (the 'Public Officials' Conduct and Lobbyist Disclosure' provisions at O.C.G.A. 21-5-70 et seq.), confirmed structurally by the 2010 vintage.

notes: Georgia consolidates lobbyist-disclosure under Title 21 (Elections) rather than splitting it across an executive-branch title. The Government Transparency and Campaign Finance Act / Ethics in Government Act both live in Title 21 Ch. 5. No parallel lobbying regime expected in Titles 45 or 50.
